data.gender_notes: Nigel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name 'Nicolaus', which means 'people of the victory'. This name was popular among early Christians and saints, including Saint Nicholas. The name Nigel carries the meaning “Victory of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nigel usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
